source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of September 27, 2026, Starbucks employed approximately 306,000 people worldwide.

payroll.label: fiscal year 2025 annual total compensation for our median employee, a part-time barista in the U.S.

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The fiscal year 2025 annual total compensation for our median employee, a part-time barista in the U.S., was $17,279.

notes: Employees: approximate head count at the September 27, 2026 fiscal year end from the FY2026 10-K (about 221,000 in the U.S.); the count is after the China retail divestiture in the third quarter. Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the January 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median is used; it is for fiscal 2025, a year behind the head count (the fiscal 2026 median will appear in the proxy due in January 2027). The median employee is a part-time barista, so the figure reflects part-time hours.
